name: magnetico-environment
description: magnetico is an autonomous (self-hosted) BitTorrent DHT indexer / crawler / search engine suite.

paths.name: Database Location
paths.description: The path where magneticod will store its database

ports.name: MAGNETICOW_PORT_MAPPING
ports.description: The port that you will access magneticow on

variables.name: MAGNETICOW_USERNAME
variables.description: Username used to access the magneticow web interface

variables.name: MAGNETICOW_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password used to access the magneticow web interface

variables.name: MAGNETICOD_NEIGHBORS
variables.description: The maximum numbers of neighbors of an indexer

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: PUID that will be set on the magneticod database folder

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: PGID that will be set on the magneticod database folder

variables.name: MAGNETICOD_ADDRESS
variables.description: IP-address used by magneticod for indexing on the DHT network

variables.name: MAGNETICOD_INTERVAL
variables.description: The indexing interval used by magneticod in seconds

variables.name: MAGNETICOD_PORT
variables.description: Port used by magneticod for indexing on the DHT network
